components.name: CanvasMotion
components.description: A responsive background canvas rendering an interactive network of constellation particles and proximity connection lines. Automatically synchronizes with screen device pixel ratio and responds to cursor coordinates.
components.code:
<script lang="ts">
	import type { HTMLCanvasAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';

	interface Props extends HTMLCanvasAttributes {
		particleCount?: number;
		particleColor?: string;
		lineColor?: string;
		maxDistance?: number;
		speed?: number;
		interactive?: boolean;
		class?: string;
	}

	let {
		particleCount = 45,
		particleColor = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.5)',
		lineColor = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)',
		maxDistance = 110,
		speed = 0.6,
		interactive = true,
		class: className = '',
		...restProps
	}: Props = $props();

	let canvasEl: HTMLCanvasElement;

	interface Particle {
		x: number;
		y: number;
		vx: number;
		vy: number;
		radius: number;
	}

	$effect(() => {
		if (!canvasEl) return;
		const canvas = canvasEl;
		const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
		if (!ctx) return;

		let animId: number;
		let width = 0;
		let height = 0;
		let particles: Particle[] = [];
		let mouse = { x: -1000, y: -1000 };

		function resize() {
			const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
			width = rect.width;
			height = rect.height;
			const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
			canvas.width = width * dpr;
			canvas.height = height * dpr;
			ctx?.scale(dpr, dpr);
		}

		function initParticles() {
			particles = [];
			for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
				particles.push({
					x: Math.random() * width,
					y: Math.random() * height,
					vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed,
					vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed,
					radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 1
				});
			}
		}

		resize();
		initParticles();

		const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
			resize();
		});
		resizeObserver.observe(canvas);

		function onPointerMove(e: PointerEvent) {
			if (!interactive) return;
			const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
			mouse.x = e.clientX - rect.left;
			mouse.y = e.clientY - rect.top;
		}

		function onPointerLeave() {
			mouse.x = -1000;
			mouse.y = -1000;
		}

		canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
		canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', onPointerLeave);

		function animate() {
			if (!ctx) return;
			ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

			// Draw particles and update positions
			for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
				const p = particles[i];
				p.x += p.vx;
				p.y += p.vy;

				if (p.x < 0 || p.x > width) p.vx *= -1;
				if (p.y < 0 || p.y > height) p.vy *= -1;

				ctx.beginPath();
				ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
				ctx.fillStyle = particleColor;
				ctx.fill();

				// Distance to mouse
				if (interactive && mouse.x > 0 && mouse.y > 0) {
					const dxM = p.x - mouse.x;
					const dyM = p.y - mouse.y;
					const distM = Math.hypot(dxM, dyM);
					if (distM < maxDistance * 1.2) {
						ctx.beginPath();
						ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
						ctx.lineTo(mouse.x, mouse.y);
						ctx.strokeStyle = lineColor;
						ctx.lineWidth = 1 - distM / (maxDistance * 1.2);
						ctx.stroke();
					}
				}

				// Connect nearby particles
				for (let j = i + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
					const p2 = particles[j];
					const dx = p.x - p2.x;
					const dy = p.y - p2.y;
					const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);

					if (dist < maxDistance) {
						ctx.beginPath();
						ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
						ctx.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y);
						ctx.strokeStyle = lineColor;
						ctx.lineWidth = (1 - dist / maxDistance) * 0.8;
						ctx.stroke();
					}
				}
			}

			animId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
		}

		animId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);

		return () => {
			cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
			resizeObserver.disconnect();
			canvas.removeEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
			canvas.removeEventListener('pointerleave', onPointerLeave);
		};
	});
</script>

<canvas
	bind:this={canvasEl}
	class="f-canvas-motion {className}"
	{...restProps}
></canvas>

<style>
	@layer fractalsvelte-ui.components {
		.f-canvas-motion {
			position: absolute;
			inset: 0;
			width: 100%;
			height: 100%;
			pointer-events: auto;
			display: block;
		}
	}
</style>

		colors = ['#10b981', '#6366f1', '#fbbf24', '#f43f5e', '#3b82f6', '#ec4899'],
		class: className = '',
		...restProps
	}: Props = $props();

	let canvasEl: HTMLCanvasElement | undefined = $state();

	interface Particle {
		x: number;
		y: number;
		vx: number;
		vy: number;
		size: number;
		color: string;
		rotation: number;
		vRot: number;
		alpha: number;
	}

	export function burst() {
		if (!canvasEl) return;
		const canvas = canvasEl;
		const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
		if (!ctx) return;

		const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
		const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
		canvas.width = rect.width * dpr;
		canvas.height = rect.height * dpr;
		ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

		const originX = rect.width / 2;
		const originY = rect.height / 2;

		const particles: Particle[] = [];
		for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
			const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
			const speed = Math.random() * 8 + 3;
			particles.push({
				x: originX,
				y: originY,
				vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
				vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 3,
				size: Math.random() * 6 + 4,
				color: colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)],
				rotation: Math.random() * 360,
				vRot: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 15,
				alpha: 1
			});
		}

		const startTime = Date.now();

		function frame() {
			if (!ctx) return;
			const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;
			if (elapsed > duration) {
				ctx.clearRect(0, 0, rect.width, rect.height);
				return;
			}

			ctx.clearRect(0, 0, rect.width, rect.height);
			const progress = elapsed / duration;

			for (const p of particles) {
				p.x += p.vx;
				p.y += p.vy;
				p.vy += 0.2; // gravity
				p.rotation += p.vRot;
				p.alpha = Math.max(0, 1 - progress);

				ctx.save();
				ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
				ctx.rotate((p.rotation * Math.PI) / 180);
				ctx.globalAlpha = p.alpha;
				ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
				ctx.fillRect(-p.size / 2, -p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
				ctx.restore();
			}

			requestAnimationFrame(frame);
		}

		requestAnimationFrame(frame);
	}
</script>

		class?: string;

	let {

		size,
		tracking = 'tight',
		weight,

		class: className = '',
		children,
		...restProps
	}: Props = $props();

	const tag = $derived<HeadingTag>(as ?? (`h${level}` as HeadingTag));

	const computedSize = $derived.by<HeadingSize>(() => {

				return 'md';

components.description: A lightweight inline SVG micro-chart displaying trend trajectories with optional gradient fill and smoothed curve strokes.
components.code:
<script lang="ts">
	import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';

	interface Props extends HTMLAttributes<SVGElement> {
		data: number[];
		width?: number;
		height?: number;
		strokeWidth?: number;
		color?: string;
		fill?: boolean;
		class?: string;
	}

	let {
		data = [10, 25, 18, 30, 45, 38, 55, 62],
		width = 120,
		height = 36,
		strokeWidth = 2,
		color = 'var(--f-primary)',
		fill = true,
		class: className = '',
		...restProps
	}: Props = $props();

	const pathData = $derived.by(() => {
		if (data.length < 2) return { line: '', area: '' };

		const min = Math.min(...data);
		const max = Math.max(...data);
		const range = max - min || 1;
		const padding = 2;

		const points = data.map((val, idx) => {
			const x = (idx / (data.length - 1)) * (width - padding * 2) + padding;
			const y = height - padding - ((val - min) / range) * (height - padding * 2);
			return `${x},${y}`;
		});

		const line = `M ${points.join(' L ')}`;
		const area = `${line} L ${width - padding},${height} L ${padding},${height} Z`;

		return { line, area };
	});
</script>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
	import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
	import type { Size } from '../../types';

	export type TextVariant =
		| 'body'
		| 'lead'
		| 'muted'
		| 'subtle'
		| 'code'
		| 'caption'
		| 'bold';

	export type TextTag =
		| 'p'
		| 'span'
		| 'div'
		| 'label'
		| 'small'
		| 'strong'
		| 'em';

	export type TextWeight = 'normal' | 'medium' | 'semibold' | 'bold';
	export type TextAlign = 'left' | 'center' | 'right' | 'justify';

	interface Props extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
		variant?: TextVariant;
		as?: TextTag;
		size?: Size;
		weight?: TextWeight;
		align?: TextAlign;
		truncate?: boolean;
		class?: string;
		children?: Snippet;
	}

	let {
		variant = 'body',
		as,
		size,
		weight,
		align,
		truncate = false,
		class: className = '',
		children,
		...restProps
	}: Props = $props();

	const tag = $derived<TextTag>(as ?? (variant === 'caption' ? 'small' : 'p'));
</script>

<svelte:element
	this={tag}
	class="f-text {className}"
	data-variant={variant}
	data-size={size}
	data-weight={weight}
	data-align={align}
	data-truncate={truncate ? '' : undefined}
	{...restProps}
>
	{#if children}
